notes: Rows are rebuilt from paper-local XML table cell contracts verified against raw/paper.xml.
Table 1 and Table 2 observations are emitted only as activity_records; Table 3 hemolysis observations are emitted only as toxicity_records.
No formulation/composition, spectroscopy, thermal, contact-angle, mechanical, or reference-column entries were emitted as activity/toxicity rows.
